name: Mikotoru
source:
"Fate has a way of forcing on the worst situations. But it's not all bad..."

One of the two self-proclaimed “angels,” God’s messengers. Seemingly, their role is to guide Rei...? Calm, knowledgeable, and highly analytical, he steadily guides Rei. However, he deflects when asked questions that get to the core of the matter.

[From [url=https://shuten-kyodan.com/en/character/]official website[/url]]

[spoiler]In truth, he is a spyware program made by humans to hack the Founder and infiltrate Shuten. His appearance is modeled off the Founder's human creator, [url=/c161698]Mikoto[/url], from within her memories.[/spoiler]
